environment: Visible in-app browser on macOS, one benchmark tab, 1280 x 800 canvas viewport; three runs per version, same tab and generated scan. Other verification tabs closed before the paired runs. Fonts/assets use normal browser caching.
fixture: largeScan(sample, 60), tests/large-scan.mjs: one open 60-screen flow, realistic sample renders repeated. Start selects the first screen. The initial overview reaches the camera minimum of 10%; a desktop switch then focuses the selected screen.

definitions.firstCanvasPaintMs: Estimate: from inserting the canvas srcdoc to two requestAnimationFrame callbacks after all 60 cheap frame wrappers exist (16 ms polling). This measures the first drawable canvas, not browser-global FCP or complete product assets.
definitions.canvasReadyMs: From insertion through boot document/font readiness and two paint opportunities.
definitions.liveIframes: Live canvas screen documents at initial overview, excluding the outer benchmark harness. Search is closed, so no preview documents exist.
definitions.deviceSwitchMs: Click desktop until its aria-pressed state is true, boot and opacity fade have finished, then two paint opportunities. Includes fades, document readiness and redraw.
definitions.afterSwitchIframes: Live canvas screen documents after the switch focuses the first screen. A selected screen always stays mounted.

reproduce: Open skills/create-flow-canvas/tests/performance.html?template=.benchmark-before.html in a visible tab; press Measure.
In the same tab open skills/create-flow-canvas/tests/performance.html; press Measure. Keep other canvas fixtures closed.

decisions.near: 300 CSS pixels outside the visible canvas after zoom; selection and active Inspect/Search/finding requests override distance. During camera flights, use the actual eased transition progress.
decisions.unmount: Serialize current product markup, native field values and scroll offsets; remove the iframe/document. Frame wrapper, label, geometry, connectors and findings remain. No detached live documents are parked.
decisions.survival: Temporary taps, field values, scroll offsets and chosen screen state survive unmount on the same device/state. Explicit state or device changes reset temporary interactions; the chosen state, including Reminders, survives device changes. Reload resets transient state. Layout save shape unchanged.
decisions.search: 150 ms debounce; unchanged tiles and serialized snapshots reused. Only previews within 300 CSS pixels of the panel viewport hold documents, at most two missing snapshots read concurrently across queries. Cancellation immediately releases requests.

verification.node: 523/523 passing under Node 22.22.2, including engine-purity and unchanged ownership guards (FrameDom API guard adds retain and tracks that live entry point).
verification.browser: 16/16 passing by pressing Run browser checks in a visible HTTP-served tests/browser.html.
